subject: Legal Notice - Ref DV/CIV/2026/338 - Rs. 9,64,000/-
body:
To,
The Managing Director,
Nexora
Mumbai

Under instructions from our client Shree Display Fabricators LLP, Vasai, we hereby give you notice as follows:

1. Our client fabricated and installed 46 branded display stands at your showrooms in Pune, Ahmedabad and Delhi between February and May 2026 under work order WO/NX/26/052.
2. The final bill of Rs. 9,64,000/- (inclusive of GST) was raised on 20.06.2026 and has remained unpaid despite reminders dated 2 August and 9 September 2026.
3. Our client has performed all obligations and no deficiency was ever notified by you.

You are called upon to pay Rs. 9,64,000/- with interest at 15% p.a. within 30 days of receipt of this notice, failing which our client shall initiate civil and, if so advised, criminal proceedings at your risk as to costs and consequences.

Yours faithfully,
Aditi Verma
Partner
Desai & Verma Associates, Advocates & Solicitors
Ballard Estate, Mumbai 400001
T: +91 22 6120 45XX

This e-mail and any attachment are privileged and confidential and meant only for the addressee. If you are not the intended recipient any use, copying or disclosure is prohibited. Please delete it and notify the sender.

subject: Notice of unlicensed software use - Ref IPC/SW/2026/091
body:
Dear Sirs,

We represent Corvex Design Software Inc. and its Indian distributor. During a licence compliance review, usage of Corvex CAD Suite (version 12) was traced to 14 workstations on Nexora's network at the Bengaluru and Hyderabad service centres, against only 4 valid licences.

Our client is willing to resolve the matter on payment of Rs. 5,80,000/- towards licence fees and settlement, together with an undertaking to remove unlicensed copies. We request your response within 14 days of this notice, failing which our client will pursue remedies under the Copyright Act, 1957.

Rohini Banerjee
Senior Associate, IP Counsel Partners
Indiranagar, Bengaluru
+91 80 4090 12XX

This communication is confidential and legally privileged.

subject: Washing machine - 4th and final complaint
body:
I purchased a Nexora washing machine for Rs 29,490 in February. Its motor has failed three times and your technicians have replaced parts each time, and the machine now fails again after 2 weeks. I have documented every visit with job sheet numbers and photographs. I have decided that if a replacement or refund is not given within 14 days I will take the matter to the District Consumer Commission, Hyderabad, with my lawyer Ms. Sandhya Reddy, and claim compensation for the inconvenience and 8 months of repeated visits.

I would much prefer to resolve this without litigation, but I am left with no other option.

Mahendra Pillai
Banjara Hills, Hyderabad
